meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把现成文字内容做成不露脸的讲解视频发出去
copy.tagline_en: Turn an article, notes or topic into a narrated explainer video with custom visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you turn written ideas into faceless explainer videos to publish online

howto.what: 把一段文字——文章、笔记、主题或简报——做成无出镜解说视频。它会挑设计系统、规划逐帧教学故事线、生成配音与音乐并逐帧搭画面，最后输出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 适合主题解说、概念拆解、操作指南等从文字讲清一件事的场景；不用于从网站生成的视频（那是 /product-launch-video），意图不清时先走 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Turns text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: it picks a design system, plans a frame-by-frame teaching story, generates narration and music, and builds each frame, outputting renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos and similar text-to-video teaching. Not for videos built from a website (that's /product-launch-video); when unclear, go to /hyperframes.
